analyst.summary: IDBI Bank has recovered from its earlier corporate-loan stress cycle and is now delivering steady, modest profit growth (around 5% year-on-year in the latest quarter). The government and LIC together still hold roughly 95% of the bank, and a long-discussed plan to sell down that stake remains unresolved with no confirmed near-term timeline -- a real catalyst for the stock, but one that has already been delayed multiple times, so it should not be assumed imminent.
